40000504.author: पदार्थः
40000504.content: तत: then, मेथावी great retentive intellectual, वेदज्ञ: knowledgeable in vedas, स: he, किञ्चित् for a little while, ध्यात्वा having pondered, तत: there after, लब्धसंज्ञ: recollected his memory, तम् that, नृपम् king, अब्रवीत् said.

40000504.author: Translation
40000504.content: Rsyasringa, a highly  intellectual and knowledgeable one in the Vedas, pondered for a while, revived his memory  and said to the king.

40000505.author: पदार्थः
40000505.content: अहम् I, ते for you, पुत्रकारणात् for begetting sons, अथर्वशिरसि in 'Atharva Siras' portion of veda, प्रोक्तै: declared, मन्त्रै: by mantras, सिद्धाम् realising the desires, पुत्रीयाम् capable of bestowing sons, इष्टिम् sacrifice, विधानत: as per tradition, करिष्यामि I will perform.

40000505.author: Translation
40000505.content: "I shall perform putriyeshti to help you beget sons. This is to be done in accordance with tradition for fulfilment of desires through mantras as declared in a portion of the Vedas, 'atharva siras'" .

40000506.author: पदार्थः
40000506.content: तत: then,  पुत्रकाराणात् for begetting  sons, पुत्रीयाम् for the sake of begetting children, ताम् इष्टिम् that sacrifice, प्राक्रम्यत् having commenced, तेजस्वी effulgent Rsyasringa मन्त्रदृष्टेन in accordance with mantras, कर्मणा with sacrificial acts,  अग्नौ in the fire, जुहाव च poured oblations.

40000506.author: Translation
40000506.content: To help Dasaratha beget sons, brilliant Rsyasringa  commenced putriyeshti, a sacrifice for begetting children, by pouring oblations into sacrificial fire and chanting mantras in accordance with traditions.

40000507.author: पदार्थः
40000507.content: तत: thereafater, सगन्धर्वा: along with gandharvas, देवा: (celestial deities) devatas, सिद्धाश्च siddhas, परमर्षय: great sages, यथाविधि according to tradition, भागप्रतिग्रहार्थम् to receive their share of offerings, समवेता: वै assembled.

40000507.author: Translation
40000507.content: All the celestial deities etc., along with gandharvas according to tradition, gathered at the sacrifice to receive their share of offerings.

40000508.author: पदार्थः
40000508.content: ता: देवता: those devatas (celestial deities), यथान्यायम् as per custom, तस्मिन् in that, सदसि assembly place, समेत्य having assembled, लोककर्तारम् creator of the worlds, ब्रह्माणम् lord Brahma, महत् important, वचनम् these words, अब्रुवन् addressed.

40000508.author: Translation
40000508.content: All devatas assembled there as per tradition and thus addressed Lord Brahma the creator of the worlds:

40000509.author: पदार्थः
40000509.content: भगवन् O Revered lord, रावणो नाम by name Ravana, राक्षस: rakshasa (demonical in nature), त्वत्प्रसादेन by your grace, वीर्यात् by the prowess, न: us, सर्वान् all, बाधते is oppressing, तम् him, शासितुम् to punish, न शक्नुम: we are not capable.

40000509.author: Translation
40000509.content: "O lord a rakshasa by name Ravana who had obtained prowess through your grace is oppressing us. We are unable to punish him.

40000510.author: पदार्थः
40000510.content: भगवन् "O Venerable lord, पुरा earlier, प्रीतेन by the well pleased, त्वया by you, तस्मै for him, वर: boon, दत्त: granted, तम् that, मानयन्त: honouring, तस्य for his, सर्वम् entirely, नित्यम् always, क्षमामहे we endure.

40000510.author: Translation
40000510.content: Pleased with his penance, Lord, you had granted him a boon. By honour that boon and daily endure all his cruelty.

40000511.author: पदार्थः
40000511.content: दुर्मति: evil minded, त्रीन् three, लोकान् worlds, उद्वेजयति inflicting pains, उच्छ्रितान् the guardians of earth, द्वेष्टि hates, त्रिदशराजानम् lord of celestial beings, शक्रम् Indra, प्रधर्षयितुम् to assault him, इच्छति he is desirous.

40000511.author: Translation
40000511.content: The evilminded Ravana is inflicting pains on the three worlds. He hates the guardians of the earth and intends to assault Indra, lord of the celestials.

40000512.author: पदार्थः
40000512.content: दुर्धष: the unassailable one, वरदानेन because of the boons, मोहित: is puffed with pride, ऋषीन् sages, यक्षान् yakshas, सगन्धर्वान् along with gandharvas, असुरान् asuras, तथा and, ब्राह्मणान् brahmins, अतिक्रामति tresspasses.

40000512.author: Translation
40000512.content: Because of your boon he has become unassailable and puffed with pride deties sages, yakshas, gandharvas, demons and brahmins.

40000513.author: पदार्थः
40000513.content: एनम् for him, सूर्य: Sun, न प्रतपति does not torment him, मारुत: wind, पार्श्वे near, न वाति does not blow, चलोर्मिमाली incessantly moving waves, समुद्रोऽपि even the ocean, तम् him, दृष्ट्वा having seen, न कम्पते does not stir (shake).

40000513.author: Translation
40000513.content: The Sun does not scorch him  and the wind does not blow by him. Even the ocean with its incessantly moving waves becomes still in his presence.

40000514.author: पदार्थः
40000514.content: तत् for that reason, घोरदर्शनात् from the one of dreadful appearance, तस्मात् from him, राक्षसात् rakshasa, न: for us, महत् great, भयम् terror, भगवन् O Lord, तस्य for his, वधार्थम्   destruction, उपायम् means, कर्तुम् to do, अर्हसि you are capable.

40000514.author: Translation
40000514.content: His dreamful appearance of that rakshasa strikes terror into us. O Lord do find some means to kill him".

40000515.author: पदार्थः
40000515.content: सर्वै: by all, सुरै: devatas, एवम् in this manner, उक्त: spoken, चिन्तयित्वा having reflected, तत: then, अब्रवीत् said, तस्य that, दुरात्मन: wickedminded, अयम् this, वधोपाय: means of destrction, विदित: is known, हन्त Oh

40000515.author: Translation
40000515.content: After listening to the words of the devatas and reflecting over the matter, Brahma said,    "Oh, the means of destruction of that wicked (rakshasa) has struck my mind".

40000516.author: पदार्थः
40000516.content: तेन by him, गन्धर्वयक्षाणाम् of (by) gandharvas and yakshas, देवदानवरक्षसाम् gods, demons and rakshasas, अवध्य: अस्मि I am incapable of being destroyed, इति in this manner, वाक् words, उक्ता spoken, मया च by me also, तत् that one, तथा be it so, उक्तम् said.

40000516.author: Translation
40000516.content: When he asked gandharvas, yakshas, gods, demons or rakshasas should never be able to kill him, I said, "So be it".

40000517.author: पदार्थः
40000517.content: तत् रक्ष: that rakshasa, अवज्ञानात् due to disdain, मानुषान् प्रति about the men, न अकीर्तयत् did not mention, तस्मात् for that reason, स: he, मानुषात् by man, वध्य: is fit to be destroyed, अस्य for him, अन्य: any other, मृत्यु: means of death, न विद्यते is not possible.

40000517.author: Translation
40000517.content: "The rakshasa did not include man monkey and bear because of his disdain for men. As such he is fit to be destroyed by a man and not by any other means".

40000518.author: पदार्थः
40000518.content: तदा then, ब्रह्मणा by Brahma, समुदाहृतम् mentioned, एतत् these, प्रियं वाक्यम् delighted  words, श्रुत्वा having heard, ते देवा: those devatas (celestial deities), महर्षय: maharshis, सर्वे all, प्रहृष्टा: अभवन् felt happy.

40000518.author: Translation
40000518.content: Having heard these pleasing words uttered by Brahma, all the devatas and maharshis were overwhelmed with joy.

40000519.author: पदार्थः
40000519.content: एतस्मिन् अन्तरे at this juncutre, माहाद्युति: highly effulgent, शङ्खचक्रगदापाणि: bearing in his hands Conch, Discus and Mace, पीतवासा: attired in yellow apparel, जगत्पति: lord of the world, विष्णु: Visnu, उपयात: arrived.

40000519.author: Translation
40000519.content: At this juncture Visnu the lord of the world, highly effulgent and bearing conch, discus and mace in his hands and in yellow apparel arrived.

40000520.author: पदार्थः
40000520.content: ब्रह्मणा by Brahma, समागम्य having met, तत्र there, समाहित: with composed mind, तस्थौ remained, सुरा: devatas, सर्वे all, सन्नता: prostrating, तम् him, समभिष्टूय paying homage with hymns, अब्रुवन् spoke.

40000520.author: Translation
40000520.content: Lord Visnu stayed there with a composed mind after meeting Brahma Then thus spoke the devatas prostrated before Visnu and paying him homage with hymns.

40000521.author: पदार्थः
40000521.content: विष्णो O Visnu, लोकानाम् for all the worlds, हितकाम्यया desirous of doing benefit, त्वाम् you, नियोक्ष्यामहे we are appointing, विष्णो OVisnu, त्वम् you, अयोध्याधिपते: of the Sovereign of Ayodhya, प्रभो: of the king, धर्मज्ञस्य of the righteous, वदान्यस्य of the generous, महर्षिसमतेजस: of one equalling rishis in lusture, तस्य his, दशरथस्य राज्ञ: king Dasaratha's ह्री श्री कीर्त्युपमासु comparable to Hri (Modesty), Shree (auspiciousness), Kirti (fame) the daughters of Daksha, तिसृषु among the three, भार्यासु wives, आत्मानम्  thy self, चतुर्विधम् in four ways, कृत्वा having divided, पुत्रत्वम् in the form of sons, आगच्छ come.

40000521.author: Translation
40000521.content: "O Visnu we pray for the welfare of all the worlds. The sovereign of Ayodhya, king Dasaratha is a righteous, virtuous and  generous king equal with rishis in lusture. Pray form into four and incarnate in the of four sons of his three wives, resembling hri (modesty), shree (auspiciousness), kirti (fame).

40000522.author: पदार्थः
40000522.content: विष्णो O Visnu, लोकानाम् for all the worlds, हितकाम्यया desirous of doing benefit, त्वाम् you, नियोक्ष्यामहे we are appointing, विष्णो OVisnu, त्वम् you, अयोध्याधिपते: of the Sovereign of Ayodhya, प्रभो: of the king, धर्मज्ञस्य of the righteous, वदान्यस्य of the generous, महर्षिसमतेजस: of one equalling rishis in lusture, तस्य his, दशरथस्य राज्ञ: king Dasaratha's ह्री श्री कीर्त्युपमासु comparable to Hri (Modesty), Shree (auspiciousness), Kirti (fame) the daughters of Daksha, तिसृषु among the three, भार्यासु wives, आत्मानम्  thy self, चतुर्विधम् in four ways, कृत्वा having divided, पुत्रत्वम् in the form of sons, आगच्छ come.

40000522.author: Translation
40000522.content: "O Visnu we pray for the welfare of all the worlds. The sovereign of Ayodhya, king Dasaratha is a righteous, virtuous and  generous king equal with rishis in lusture. Pray form into four and incarnate in the of four sons of his three wives, resembling hri (modesty), shree (auspiciousness), kirti (fame).

40000523.author: पदार्थः
40000523.content: विष्णो: O Visnu, त्वम् you, तत्र there, मानुष: in the form of man, भूत्वा having been born, प्रवृद्धम् increasingly becoming arrogant, लोककण्टकम् source of vexation and terror to the worlds, दैवतै: by gods, अवध्यम् invincible, रावणम् Ravana, समरे in the battle, जहि slay.

40000523.author: Translation
40000523.content: "O Visnu assuring human form, kill Ravana in the battle. He has become a source of torment to the worlds and is invincible by gods.

40000524.author: पदार्थः
40000524.content: स: that, मूर्ख: dull headed, राक्षस: rakshasa, रावण: Ravana, देवांश्च gods, गन्धर्वान् gandharvas, सिद्धांश्च siddhas, मुनिसत्तमान् great rishis, वीर्योत्सेकेन by his haughty prowess, बाधते हि is tormenting indeed.

40000524.author: Translation
40000524.content: "That stupid rakshasa, Ravana, with his haughty prowess, is terrorising the gods, gandharvas, siddhas and great rishis.

40000525.author: पदार्थः
40000525.content: तत: thus, तेन that, क्रूरेण by the cruel one, ऋषयश्च rishis, तथा and, नन्दनवने in Nandana groves, क्रीडन्त: sporting, गन्धर्वाप्सरस: gandharvas and apsaras, हिंसिता: किल are reported to be tortured.

40000525.author: Translation
40000525.content: It is reported that a cruel rakshasa with his haughty prowess has tortured rishis, gandharvas and apsaras sporting in Nandana groves.

40000526.author: पदार्थः
40000526.content: वयम् we, सिद्धगन्धर्वयक्षाश्च siddhas, gandharvas and yakshas, मुनिभि: सह along with ascetics, तस्य his, वधार्थम् in order to kill him, आयाता: have come, तत: for that reason, त्वाम् you, शरणम् गता: we have taken refuge in you.

40000526.author: Translation
40000526.content: We siddhas, gandharvas and yakshas along with ascetics, have hence come here to devise ways of his death. We take refuge in you.

40000527.author: पदार्थः
40000527.content: परन्तप OTormentor of enemies, देव OVisnu, त्वम् you, न: सर्वेषाम् for all of us, परमा supreme, गति: refuge, देवशत्रूणाम् of the enemies of gods (rakshasas), वधाय for the destruction, नृणाम् लोके in the world of men, मन: mind, कुरु resolve.

40000527.author: Translation
40000527.content: O tormentor of enemies, O Visnu, you are the supreme, refuge for all of us. Resolve to be born in the world of men for the destruction of enemies of the gods (rakshasas)".

40000528.author: पदार्थः
40000528.content: त्रिदशपुङ्गव: foremost of gods, सर्वलोकनमस्कृत: bowed by all in the worlds, देवेश: lord of devatas, celestial beings, विष्णु: Visnu, एवम् in this manner, उक्त: addressed, समेतान् assembled, धर्मसंहितान् guided by law of righteousness, पितामहपुरोगान् led by the grand  sire, तान् those, सर्वान् all, त्रिदशान् gods, अब्रवीत् spoke.

40000528.author: Translation
40000528.content: Visnu, the lord of the celestials, foremost among the gods and bowed by all in the worlds addressed the assembled devatas who were guided by the law of righteousness and were led by the grand sire, Brahma.

40000529.author: पदार्थः
40000529.content: त्रिदशपुङ्गव: foremost of gods, सर्वलोकनमस्कृत: bowed by all in the worlds, देवेश: lord of devatas, celestial beings, विष्णु: Visnu, एवम् in this manner, उक्त: addressed, समेतान् assembled, धर्मसंहितान् guided by law of righteousness, पितामहपुरोगान् led by the grand  sire, तान् those, सर्वान् all, त्रिदशान् gods, अब्रवीत् spoke.

40000529.author: Translation
40000529.content: Visnu, the lord of the celestials, foremost among the gods and bowed by all in the worlds addressed the assembled devatas who were guided by the law of righteousness and were led by the grand sire, Brahma.

40000530.author: पदार्थः
40000530.content: भयम् fear, त्यजत abandon, भद्रम् blessings (to you), व: for your, हितार्थम् welfare, सपुत्रपौत्रम् along with his sons and grandsons, सामात्यम् along with his ministesrs, समित्रज्ञाति बान्धवम् along with friends, relations and allies, क्रूरम् cruel, दुरात्मानम् wicked minded, देवर्षीणाम् for gods and rishis, भयावहम् dreadful, रावणम् Ravana, युधि in the battle, हत्वा after killing, इमाम् पृथिवीम् this earth, पालयन् while ruling, दशवर्षसहस्राणि ten thousand years, दशवर्षशतानि ten hundred years, मानुषे लोके in the world of men, वत्स्यामि I will dwell.

40000530.author: Translation
40000530.content: Abandon your fear and may you be blessed; for your welfare I shall slay in battle the cruel, wicked Ravana, dreadful to gods and sages, together with his sons, grandsons, ministers, friends, kinsmen and allies, and then dwell in the world of men, ruling this earth for eleven thousand years.

40000531.author: पदार्थः
40000531.content: भयम् fear, त्यजत abandon, भद्रम् blessings (to you), व: for your, हितार्थम् welfare, सपुत्रपौत्रम् along with his sons and grandsons, सामात्यम् along with his ministesrs, समित्रज्ञाति बान्धवम् along with friends, relations and allies, क्रूरम् cruel, दुरात्मानम् wicked minded, देवर्षीणाम् for gods and rishis, भयावहम् dreadful, रावणम् Ravana, युधि in the battle, हत्वा after killing, इमाम् पृथिवीम् this earth, पालयन् while ruling, दशवर्षसहस्राणि ten thousand years, दशवर्षशतानि ten hundred years, मानुषे लोके in the world of men, वत्स्यामि I will dwell.

40000531.author: Translation
40000531.content: Abandon your fear and may you be blessed; for your welfare I shall slay in battle the cruel, wicked Ravana, dreadful to gods and sages, together with his sons, grandsons, ministers, friends, kinsmen and allies, and then dwell in the world of men, ruling this earth for eleven thousand years.

40000532.author: पदार्थः
40000532.content: आत्मवान् the highest soul, विष्णु: देव: lord Visnu, देवानाम् for devatas, एवम् in this manner, वरम् boon, दत्वा having given, अथ there after, आत्मन: for himself, मानुषे in the world of men, जन्मभूमिम् place of birth, चिन्तयामास reflected.

40000532.author: Translation
40000532.content: Lord Visnu, supreme soul having given boon to devatas in this manner, reflected as to the place where he should take birth as a man in this world of men.

40000533.author: पदार्थः
40000533.content: तत: thereafter, पद्मपलाशाक्ष: lord having eyes resembling lotus petals, तदा then, आत्मानम् himself, चतुर्विधम् in four ways, कृत्वा having made, दशरथम् नृपम् king Dasaratha, तथा पितरम् as father, रोचयामास liked.

40000533.author: Translation
40000533.content: Thereafter, the Lord with eyes like the lotus petal was pleased to transform himself into four forms and to choose king Dasaratha as his father.

40000534.author: पदार्थः
40000534.content: तदा then, सरुद्रा: along with rudras, साप्सरोगणा: along with groups of apsaras, देवर्षिगन्धर्वा: devatas, rishis and gandharvas, दिव्यरूपाभि: celestial beauty, स्तुतिभि: hymns, मधुसूदनम् slayer of Madhu, तुष्टुवु: praised.

40000534.author: Translation
40000534.content: Then along with gandharvas, groups of apsaras, rishis, rudras and devatas sang in praise of the 'Lord Slayer of Madhu', with hymns of celestial beauty.

40000535.author: पदार्थः
40000535.content: उद्धतम् inflamed, उग्रतेजसम् one with frightful prowess, प्रवृद्धदर्पम् having fully grown insolence, त्रिदशेश्वरद्विषम् the enemy of the lord of gods (Indra ), तपस्विकण्टकम् source of vexation to ascetics, तपस्विनाम् for maharshis, भयावहम् dreadful, तम् him, तम् रावणम् that Ravana, विरावणम् he who causes grerat agony in the three worlds making people cry loudly, साधु rightly, उद्धर uproot him.

40000535.author: Translation
40000535.content: "Therefore, uproot that mighty Ravana possessing frightful prowess, inflamed pride, limitless insolence causing agony to the three worlds, a source of vexation to ascetics and  a dreadful enemy of Indra.

40000536.author: पदार्थः
40000536.content: सबलम् along with his forces, सबान्धवम् with his relations, विरावणम् causing distress in  the worlds, अग्य्रपौरुषम् having foremost manliness, तम् एव him only, रावणम् Ravana, हत्वा having slain, चिरम् in long time, गतज्वर: purged of distress, सुरेन्द्रगुप्तम् protected by Indra, गतदोषकल्मषम् freed from faults and sins, स्वर्लोकम् celestial region, आगच्छ return.

40000536.author: Translation
40000536.content: Kill Ravana, the cause of distress in the worlds, kill his forces and relatives. Them return to heaven  protected by Indra after freeing from distress, faults and sins". इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये बालकाण्डे पञ्चदशस्सर्ग:।। Thus ends the fifteenth sarga of Balakanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
